subject: Post-demo: test matrix + p95/p99 & tokens/sec clarification
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@stellahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed test matrix (p95/p99 & tokens/sec)

Thanks again for the demo time today — good signals on the integration points and the dataset you shared. Quick recap and a concrete ask so we can get the A/B bench scheduled: 

What we heard (high level):
- Primary goal: pick a winner for production inference that meets your latency SLOs for interactive clinical workflows (p95 <= 250ms on short prompts; p99 target TBD) and sustains throughput for nightly batch jobs (tokens/sec matters).
- Competitive axis: Hyperscale provider (Will) vs Redwood-hosted vs in-house RL inference (if you run experiments).
- Dataset: 10k clinical Q&A pairs + 1k long-context notes for stress tests.

Proposed immediate deliverables (attached action-matrix.xlsx):
1) Confirm p95 and p99 latency targets for two profiles:
   - Interactive (avg prompt length ~80 tokens) -> p95 target? (we proposed 250ms)
   - Long-context/summary (avg 1,500 tokens) -> p95 target?
2) Agree on tokens/sec goals for nightly batch (we propose target bands: 50k, 200k tokens/sec depending on provisioning).
3) Test matrix we want to run (short description):
   - A/B1: Redwood (quantized 4-bit + KV cache) vs Hyperscale FP16
   - A/B2: Redwood auto-batching vs Hyperscale request-level parallelism (same CPU/GPU counts)
   - Stress: 2048-token long-context p95/p99 at 1x and 5x concurrency

Next steps for us: we can provision the harness and run the first sweep if you confirm targets and grant access to the dataset location. I attached the recording and a draft test-harness-spec.md.

Can you confirm the p95/p99 targets and whether we should include Will's Hyperscale config in the initial sweep (we'll need his sample endpoint + expected QPS)?

Thanks — I’ll queue Ben and Jordan to scope the run once we get your confirmation.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: action-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), call-recording-20270811.mp4 (audio), test-harness-spec.md (doc)

From: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@stellahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed test matrix (p95/p99 & tokens/sec)

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and the recording. High level confirmation and answers: 

- Interactive profile: p95 target = 300ms (we're willing to accept up to 350ms while prioritizing accuracy). p99 target = 600ms.
- Long-context/summaries: p95 target = 1.2s, p99 = 2.5s. These are soft but would be great to validate.
- Tokens/sec for nightly batch: target band = 100k tokens/sec (this is for current batch windows). If you can show a path to 200k with moderate infra increase that's valuable.

Regarding Hyperscale: please include Will's team. Will — can you confirm the endpoint and a FP16 config for parity?

Dataset: we'll share the 10k Q&A (anonymized) via the shared drive link you provided. For the long-context set we will send a separate S3 temporary URL.

We want the first sweep to include: Redwood quantized + Hyperscale FP16. If results look close, we can add an exact-match accuracy check and a repeat with cold-cache runs.

Availability: we can start a run next Wednesday (18 Aug) afternoon PT if you can confirm infra requirements. Please send an estimate of compute and a rough ETA for results (turnaround in hours).

— Sarah
Sarah Hayes
Director of Clinical AI, Stella Health
sarah.hayes@stellahealth.com

Quoted text:
> On Wed, 11 Aug 2027 at 15:02, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@stellahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed test matrix (p95/p99 & tokens/sec)

Thanks Sarah — great to have targets. Quick technical plan and ask from our side so we can size infra and schedule: 

Test harness summary (high level):
- Workloads: short prompt (80 tokens), medium (512 tokens), long (1,500–2,048 tokens).
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec (sustained), 95th latency under cold vs warm cache, cost-per-1M-tokens estimate.
- Comparison arms: Redwood quantized (4-bit) w/ KV cache + batching; Hyperscale FP16 endpoint (we'll use their sample endpoint and match concurrency); optional in-house (customer-run) for later.

Concrete infra ask for initial sweep (estimate):
- Redwood: 4x A100 equivalent for throughput bands; will run controlled QPS ramps (1x, 3x, 5x).
- Hyperscale: ask Will to confirm matching instance class and concurrency.

Schedule & deliverables: 
- Wed 18 Aug: provision infra + verify dataset upload and access.
- Thu 19 Aug: run baseline short prompt sweep (p95/p99) and deliver preliminary dashboard by EOD.
- Fri 20 Aug: run long-context stress runs and deliver final report (CSV + charts) on Monday morning.

Links & artifacts:
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/stella/stella-bench-2027 (dataset + harness)
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/STELLA-145

Jordan will own the runs and Ben will surface the infra cost/quote to Marissa for procurement. Marissa — can you prepare a quote for the committed capacity (monthly reserved pool) if Stella wants a reserved option after the sweep?

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks for confirming Sarah.

Action items (I’ll own coordination):
- Jordan/Ben: provision Redwood infra and validate harness (start Wed 18 Aug).
- Will (cc'ed separately): please confirm FP16 endpoint details so Jordan can mirror the test.
- Marissa: please prepare a on-demand quote for the reserved capacity and a short note on procurement lead times; copy Sarah on pricing PDF.
- Stella: upload the dataset to the Drive link and send the S3 URL for long-context set.

I’ll open a HubSpot activity and attach the action-matrix + schedule. We’ll aim to deliver the baseline short-prompt sweep by Thu 19 Aug EOD. If preliminary numbers show Redwood within 10% of Hyperscale on p95 and we meet tokens/sec targets, we’ll propose a deeper run (cold-cache + accuracy checks).

See you all on the run — I’ll ping once infra is provisioned.

Best,
Karthik
